notes.s: Jin's solo: the person he was supposed to love turns out to be himself.
notes.t: Jin's solo and the comeback trailer for Love Yourself 結 Answer, August 2018, a straight rock ballad that lands the 結 resolution. Heard against the other three solos it works as a reply: Euphoria made someone else the cause and Serendipity made someone else the rescue, and this one withdraws the question from them. The series finishes its argument on Answer: Love Myself, but fans point here as the place the turn actually happens, because the self-erasure gets named first and refused second rather than skipped. It is also the track most often cited for the vocal rather than the concept.
k: 맞추다 is tuning one thing to another, the verb for setting a watch or adjusting seasoning. The line is not I pleased you; it is I reset my own settings to yours. That is why what follows treats it as a loss of shape rather than as an act of kindness, and why the storm is in his own chest.

가면 is a theatrical or carnival mask, and 가면을 쓰다 is the ordinary idiom for concealing your real self. The smiling-mask image runs straight into the persona thread the group built an entire later album around, so this is the hinge between Love Yourself and Map of the Soul.

이제 is now, and the -야 particle adds not until. So the line carries a reproach at himself for how late the realisation is, which plain now I realise throws away. One particle is holding the emotional weight of the chorus.
너무 아름다운 걸, 내가 곧 나인 걸

-ㄴ 걸 contracts -ㄴ 것을 and works as a sentence ending for something just understood and half announced to yourself. It is why the chorus sounds like a discovery rather than a declaration, and it is everywhere in Korean ballads once you can hear it.

vocab.note: 시계를 맞추다 set a watch, 간을 맞추다 season to taste; the object is what gets adapted
Usually of a burden that may exceed you, so 감당할 수 없다 is very common
가면을 쓰다 is the idiom for hiding your true self

vocab.en: appearance, form, the way one is
vocab.note: Wider than face or looks; 내 모습 is nearer to who I am
Transitive; 드러나다 is for something coming to light on its own
ㄷ-irregular, so the ㄷ becomes ㄹ before a vowel and gives 깨달아
Of supplies and of people; used about yourself it is modest rather than harsh
Causative of 숨다, to hide oneself
Of a pencil tip or a nose; the opposite of 날카롭다

vocab.en: that sort of thing, the likes of
vocab.note: Dismissive. Aimed at a person it is rude, so it is usually aimed at a thing

vocab.en: up to now, all this time
vocab.note: -껏 attaches to time words meaning as far as, also 여태껏 and 아직껏
